 PlayStation Black Friday Sale: Marvel’s Wolverine, 007 First Light And Other Games Get Major Discounts
 oi
 -Divyanshi Sharma By Divyanshi Sharma 
 Published: Wednesday,
 November 4, 2026, 12:10 [IST]
 Add as a
 preferred source on Google PlayStation fans in India have a good reason to check the PlayStation Store this Black Friday. Sony has rolled out discounts on several PS5 and PS4 games, including popular titles such as Marvel's Wolverine, 007 First Light, ASTRO BOT and The Blood of Dawnwalker.
 The PlayStation Black Friday 2026 sale will run until November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM local time. However, the offers listed below currently show an earlier expiry date of November 21 at 5:29 AM IST. So, if you have been waiting to pick up a particular game at a lower price, you may want to check these deals before they expire.
 Here are some of the biggest PlayStation game discounts available in India.
 007 First Light and Marvel's Wolverine get major discounts 
 One of the biggest discounts in the current PlayStation Black Friday sale is on the 007 First Light Deluxe Edition . The game is available for Rs 2,399, down from its original price of Rs 4,799. This translates into a 50% discount, saving buyers Rs 2,400.
 Marvel's Wolverine Digital Deluxe Edition is also available at a reduced price. It is listed at Rs 4,311 instead of Rs 5,599, giving buyers a discount of 23%. The game has an average rating of 4.63 out of 5 stars from around 65,000 ratings on the PlayStation Store.
 Meanwhile, SAROS Digital Deluxe Edition is also available for Rs 4,311, down from Rs 5,599. This is another 23% discount, saving buyers Rs 1,288.
 Other PS5 games available at discounted prices 
 Apart from these major titles, PlayStation is offering discounts on several other games. ASTRO BOT Standard Edition is available for Rs 2,839, compared to its original price of Rs 3,999. This gives buyers a 29% discount, saving Rs 1,160. The game has an average rating of 4.77 out of 5 stars from around 77,000 ratings.
 The Blood of Dawnwalker Eclipse Edition is listed at Rs 3,839, down from Rs 4,799. Buyers can save Rs 960 with this 20% discount. The game has an average rating of 4.56 out of 5 stars from around 14,000 ratings.
 Another deal worth checking out is PRAGMATA Deluxe Edition , which is available for Rs 3,519 instead of Rs 4,399. This brings the price down by 20%, saving buyers Rs 880.
 Silent Hill Townfall Standard Edition is also part of the sale. It is available for Rs 2,399, down from Rs 2,999, giving buyers a 20% discount.
 The Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred Standard Edition is available for Rs 2,249, compared to its listed price of Rs 2,999. This translates into a 25% discount, saving buyers Rs 750.
 The game supports both PS4 and PS5, and is also marked as PS5 Pro Enhanced on the PlayStation Store.
 When does the PlayStation Black Friday sale end in India?
 The PlayStation Black Friday 2026 sale is scheduled to run until November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM local time. However, the individual game offers listed above show an expiry date of November 21, 2026, at 5:29 AM IST.
 This means the discounts on these specific titles may end before the overall sale does. Prices and availability may also vary, so it is worth checking the PlayStation Store listing before making a purchase.
